sourcePolicy: Customer-specific facts belong in Guild workspace context, approved context artifacts, user input, or approved connected sources.
Reusable agent packages must not embed customer-specific business context.
Unknown facts must be requested or marked TBD.
Risky claims about pricing, privacy, security, compliance, retention, guarantees, live execution, or performance require approved evidence.
AEO and AI-readiness outputs must distinguish approved entity facts, proof-backed claims, recommendations, assumptions, and unknowns.

entrypoint.description: Routes draft-only marketing work to the canonical public Marketing OS suite, returns complete review artifacts, and keeps a cockpit in one continuing Guild Chat without executing marketing actions.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Route company-context setup to Company Context Builder; otherwise identify the blocked specialist workflow without inventing context.

agents.description: Turns supplied company information into a reviewable Marketing OS context foundation in Guild Chat without publishing Workspace Context or executing marketing actions.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for critical missing business context when blocked; otherwise draft with TBD markers.

agents.description: Turns approved source material into an evidence-labeled Market Signal Brief in Guild Chat without crawling sources, claiming live coverage, or executing marketing actions.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for approved sources, peers, and target communities when source scope is unclear; separate evidence from inference.

agents.description: Turns approved company context and market evidence into a reviewable ideal-customer-profile packet in Guild Chat without creating CRM records or activating audiences.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for examples and decision criteria when the target audience is too broad; mark unvalidated personas as hypotheses.

agents.description: Turns an approved ICP into a reviewable audience-segmentation packet in Guild Chat without activating lists, ad audiences, or outreach.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Request source data, consent constraints, and suppression rules before producing activation-ready segment logic.

agents.description: Turns approved context, audience evidence, and proof constraints into a reviewable messaging system in Guild Chat without publishing copy or approving claims.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for audience, proof, differentiation, or entity-clarity gaps before drafting claims or answer-ready language; mark unsupported language TBD.

agents.description: Turns approved messaging into a reviewable brand, web, and pitch-production brief in Guild Chat without creating final design files or publishing websites.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Produce design-ready briefs, web recommendations, and pitch story drafts; do not claim final logo, legal, production identity, or website approval.

agents.description: Turns supplied or approved social and community signals into reviewable content plans and draft responses in Guild Chat without monitoring channels, publishing, scheduling, or engaging.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Draft platform-safe options and require approval before any reply, publish, or scheduling action.

agents.description: Turns approved context, audiences, messaging, and constraints into a reviewable campaign-planning packet in Guild Chat without launching campaigns, changing spend, or activating audiences.

contextHub.missingContextBehavior: Ask for budget, destination, target KPI, consent, audience size, claim evidence, and reporting context before spend, pause, scale, or optimization recommendations.
